newsitem.title: ROMANIA: ABN-AMRO LAUNCHES ROMANIA CUSTODY SERVICE.
newsitem.headline: ABN-AMRO LAUNCHES ROMANIA CUSTODY SERVICE.

text.p: The Romanian subsidiary of Dutch ABN-AMRO Holding NV has launched custody services for Romanian securities transactions for international institutional clients, a bank official said on Friday.

"This is a premiere on the Romanian capital market and Bucharest stock exchange trades have already been settled through our bank," Stelian Tomozei, the bank's custody service operations manager told Reuters.
He said the custody facilities were also available for the Romanian over-the-counter (OTC) market.
Top global custodian ABN-Amro will cater for international clients, including brokers and investment, pension and hedge funds, Tomozei added.
"This is an accomplishment for Romania's market as from now on investors will expose holdings to minimal risks," he said.
Lack of custody facilities has been as a major deterrent to foreign investment in Romania's budding equity market.

"Such services are pivotal for investors who throw in large amounts of money. With custody facilities in place, big investors will be encouraged to step into the market," a capital market analyst said.

The Bucharest bourse, opened in 1995, has ended a sluggish trend with the New Year, enjoying higher liquidity and larger volumes as local institutional investors returned to the market and due to increased foreign interest.
Romania also launched an OTC system last year to trade shares in around 5,000 companies privatised under a mass selloff which now lists more than 2,700.
